data.name: Fortunia
data.gender_notes: Fortunia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Roman mythology, Fortunia is the goddess of good fortune, prosperity, and protection. Her name comes from the Latin word 'fortuna', meaning 'fortune'. She was often depicted as a woman with a cornucopia, symbolizing abundance and prosperity. The name Fortunia carries the meaning “Fortune, prosperity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fortunia usually hope their child will grow to embody fortune, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing divine favor, blessings, and protection.
data.etymology: Fortunia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortune, prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fortunia total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Τουκτίδια

data.cultural_impact: The Christian name "Fortunia" pays a tribute to the Roman goddess Fortuna, emphasizing a hope for good fortune, blessings, and protection in life. It is a reminder of the belief that we are dependent on the will of a higher power for our prosperity and well-being. This name also offers a connection to the rich cultural history of ancient Rome and its religious traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Fortunia" is a powerful reminder of the belief that God, as the ultimate source of all blessings, has the power to grant us good fortune, prosperity, and protection in our lives. It emphasizes faith and trust in God's divine plan and encourages us to remain hopeful and optimistic, even in the face of adversity. It serves as a reminder that our lives are not solely in our hands, but in God's, and that with faith, we can overcome challenges and achieve success.
